versions.subject: LOLBIN Updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\MSPUB.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'MSPUB.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'http://'
        - 'https://'
        - 'ftp://'
condition: all of selection*
